import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "585fbf9340de57a9bc6fcd662e5979bb37a9c7c9"

def run(args, cwd=wt):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
branch = run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).strip()
status = run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()
if head != expected or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007" or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} branch={branch} status={status!r}")

needles = [
    "maximum length", "max length", "rollover", "conversation", "chat_url",
    "create_target", "create chat", "new chat", "project_record", "bootstrap",
    "archive", "sidebar", "handoff", "lineage", "pending_receipts",
]
for rel in [
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/browser/__init__.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    "src/do_again/service/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/cli.py",
    "tests/test_browser.py",
    "tests/test_browser_hardening.py",
    "tests/test_daemon.py",
]:
    p = wt / rel
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines = p.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
    hits = []
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        low=line.lower()
        if any(n.lower() in low for n in needles):
            hits.append(i)
    windows=[]
    for hit in hits:
        start=max(1,hit-5); end=min(len(lines),hit+15)
        if any(not (end < a or start > b) for a,b in windows):
            continue
        windows.append((start,end))
        print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
        for n in range(start,end+1):
            print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")

candidates = [
    "6ac69a7a-6fe8-83e8-b3f4-6f0c333df723",
    "6ac69ad4-6524-83e8-827f-d1f93b18f5dd",
    "6ac69ba8-fe28-83e8-aee5-87a87a77258a",
    "6ac69bd2-b3d0-83e8-9747-9cc5ed3516ef",
]
print("=== candidate references in isolated repo ===")
for cid in candidates:
    proc = subprocess.run(["git","grep","-n",cid], cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True)
    print(cid)
    print(proc.stdout or "(none)")

print("=== runtime layout metadata paths only ===")
home = Path.home()/".do_again"
for p in sorted(home.glob("projects/*/runtime.json")):
    try:
        data=json.loads(p.read_text())
    except Exception:
        continue
    print(json.dumps({
        "runtime_json": str(p),
        "repo": data.get("repo"),
        "browser_enabled": data.get("browser_enabled"),
    }, sort_keys=True))
